source.report_note: Limits: Fluke 753/754 Calibration Manual, Performance Verification Tests (1-year column), unchanged except the 30 V dc row of Table 3 (printed maximum 29.9870, a misprint; 30.0065 used). Points marked (UUT input) were sourced by the calibrator named in the standards used; points marked (UUT output) were read on an external measuring instrument and typed in, and their Uncertainty is that of the measuring standard named in the row. Thermocouple points are Type K.
source.note: Fluke 753/754 Calibration Manual, Performance Verification Tests, printed pp. 9-32 (16 tables: 8 measure, 7 source, loop power; plus the 754-only HART check). The UUT is itself a calibrator: where it MEASURES (Tables 3-7, 13, 15, 16) the lab calibrator sources the value and the display is typed; where it SOURCES (Tables 8-12, 14, 17, loop power) the reading is MANUAL ENTRY of the external meter (the manual: Fluke 8508A DMM, Tektronix FCA3000 counter). 1-year limits are used; 2-year limits are stored in the spec. The only thermocouple type the manual verifies is Type K. Table 3 row 30 V prints a 1-year maximum of 29.9870 (misprint): 30.0065 is used.

754.name: Fluke 754 Documenting Process Calibrator

MEAS_V.title: Change the cables: UUT measures volts / frequency
MEAS_V.summary: Fluke 5522A (the manual's calibrator, Table 2; a 5560A or 5520A can be chosen in the window) NORMAL HI / LO -> UUT V jack and the UUT COM jack on the MEASURE side (Figure 1 and Figure 4).
steps: Put the calibrator (or the source) in STANDBY before you rewire (in manual mode, put it in STANDBY yourself).
NORMAL HI (red) to the UUT right-hand jack labelled V (CAT II 300 V MAX); NORMAL LO (black) to the UUT jack directly below it (MEASURE common).
Set the UUT to the function and range of the point (the point window says which); lock the range with the Range softkey.
Compare your connections with the picture, then continue.
MEAS_V.caution: Up to 295 V is applied. Use CAT-rated leads and keep clear of the plugs whenever the output is on. Do not force a dual banana plug into two jacks horizontally (printed p. 10).

MEAS_MA.title: Change the cables: UUT measures dc mA
MEAS_MA.summary: Fluke 5522A (the manual's calibrator, Table 2; a 5560A or 5520A can be chosen in the window) AUX HI -> 8508A (series, optional) -> UUT mA jack; UUT MEASURE common -> AUX LO (Figure 2).
steps: Put the calibrator (or the source) in STANDBY before you rewire (in manual mode, put it in STANDBY yourself).

Calibrator current output (5522A AUX HI / AUX LO) in series with the UUT mA jack (mA Omega RTD, middle top) and the common jack below it (Figure 2). The manual puts an 8508A in series; it is optional here.
Disconnect the jumpers on the three common jacks if present (printed p. 13). Set the UUT to dc current, lock the range (30 mA, then 100 mA).
Compare your connections with the picture, then continue.

MEAS_OHM.title: Change the cables: UUT measures resistance
MEAS_OHM.summary: Fluke 5522A (the manual's calibrator, Table 2; a 5560A or 5520A can be chosen in the window) four-wire output, two-wire at the UUT (both HI leads on the UUT mA Omega RTD jack, both LO leads on the jack below it), two-wire compensation ON (Figure 3).
steps: Put the calibrator (or the source) in STANDBY before you rewire (in manual mode, put it in STANDBY yourself).

Four-wire connection at the calibrator (NORMAL HI / LO and AUX SENSE HI / LO), both HI leads together on the UUT middle top jack (mA Omega RTD) and both LO leads together on the UUT middle bottom jack. Two-wire compensation ON at the calibrator (set on its front panel; the program does not).
Set the UUT to resistance measurement, lock the range with the Range softkey.
Compare your connections with the picture, then continue.

MEAS_TC.title: Change the cables: UUT measures a thermocouple (Type K)
MEAS_TC.summary: Type K thermocouple wire from the calibrator TC output to the UUT TC mini-plug jack (left, +/-). UUT: Type K, ITS-90, internal reference, degC.
steps: Put the calibrator (or the source) in STANDBY before you rewire (in manual mode, put it in STANDBY yourself).

Calibrator TC output -> Type K thermocouple wire -> UUT TC jack, polarity as marked. The calibrator simulates a Type K thermocouple (the program sends TC_TYPE K). (The manual itself sources dc mV through a lag bath, Figure 10.)
Thermocouple measure function, TC Type K, ITS-90, internal reference, degC. Wait about a minute for the connection to settle.
Compare your connections with the picture, then continue.

MEAS_RTD4.title: Change the cables: UUT measures a four-wire RTD
MEAS_RTD4.summary: Four-wire resistance from the calibrator to the UUT: HI leads on the UUT mA Omega RTD and V jacks, LO leads on the two jacks below them (Figure 11); four-wire compensation ON.
steps: Put the calibrator (or the source) in STANDBY before you rewire (in manual mode, put it in STANDBY yourself).
Four-wire connection and four-wire compensation ON at the calibrator (front panel; the program does not set it). The calibrator output is the resistance equivalent of the temperature.
RTD measure function, Pt100 (385), ITS-90, four-wire termination.
Compare your connections with the picture, then continue.

MEAS_RTD3.title: Change the cables: UUT measures a three-wire RTD
MEAS_RTD3.summary: Three-wire resistance from the calibrator to the UUT (Figure 12); four-wire compensation OFF.
steps: Put the calibrator (or the source) in STANDBY before you rewire (in manual mode, put it in STANDBY yourself).

Three-wire connection as Figure 12 (a lead on the UUT mA Omega RTD jack, a lead on the V jack, a jumper between the two lower jacks): read from the figure, UNVERIFIED. Compensation OFF at the calibrator.
RTD measure function, Pt100 (385), ITS-90, three-wire termination.
Compare your connections with the picture, then continue.

SRC_V.title: Change the cables: UUT sources dc volts
SRC_V.summary: UUT SOURCE jacks (VOhm RTD, left top; common below it) -> external DMM INPUT HI / LO (Figure 5).
steps: Put the calibrator (or the source) in STANDBY before you rewire (in manual mode, put it in STANDBY yourself).
External DMM (the manual: Fluke 8508A) in dc volts.
Set the UUT to the dc volts source function at -10 mV and let it warm up for at least 5 minutes before the first reading (printed p. 17). At the end push CLEAR twice to turn the source off.
Compare your connections with the picture, then continue.

SRC_MA.title: Change the cables: UUT sources dc mA
SRC_MA.summary: UUT mA source jack (middle top) and common below it -> external DMM A input and LO (Figure 6).
steps: Put the calibrator (or the source) in STANDBY before you rewire (in manual mode, put it in STANDBY yourself).
Set the UUT to the dc current source function (NOT simulate transmitter) at 2 mA. Push CLEAR twice at the end (printed p. 18).
Compare your connections with the picture, then continue.

SRC_SIM.title: Change the cables: UUT simulates a transmitter
SRC_SIM.summary: UUT mA jack and common (as Figure 6) in series with the external DMM (current) and the calibrator as an 8 V dc loop supply (Figure 7).
steps: Put the calibrator (or the source) in STANDBY before you rewire (in manual mode, put it in STANDBY yourself).
The 5522A supplies 8 V dc (the program sets it); its value is not critical (printed p. 19).
External DMM in dc current in the loop.
mA Source function, Simulate Transmitter, 4 mA then 22 mA (the table points are 4 mA and 21 mA, printed p. 20).
Compare your connections with the picture, then continue.
SRC_SIM.caution: 8 V dc is applied to the loop. Keep the calibrator in STANDBY while you change the connections.

SRC_OHM.title: Change the cables: UUT sources resistance / RTD
SRC_OHM.summary: UUT SOURCE jacks, both HI on the VOhm RTD jack and both LO on the jack below it (two wires at the UUT) -> external DMM four-wire ohms (Figure 8).
steps: Put the calibrator (or the source) in STANDBY before you rewire (in manual mode, put it in STANDBY yourself).
External DMM in four-wire ohms: 200 ohm range for the first five resistance points, autorange after (printed p. 20); RTD source: four-wire ohms autorange (printed p. 29).
Resistance source at 0.1 ohm (RTD source: Pt100 (385) at -180 C, ITS-90). Push CLEAR twice at the end.
Compare your connections with the picture, then continue.

SRC_FREQ.title: Change the cables: UUT sources frequency
SRC_FREQ.summary: UUT SOURCE jacks -> BNC adapter -> frequency counter (Tektronix FCA3000) and the Fluke 123 channel A (Figure 9).
steps: Put the calibrator (or the source) in STANDBY before you rewire (in manual mode, put it in STANDBY yourself).
Frequency counter on the UUT output; the Fluke 123 (channel A, BNC input) shows the waveform (printed pp. 21-22).
Source, frequency, 1.000 Vpp, square wave, 5 Hz first (printed p. 21); the sine points follow Table 12 order; push CLEAR twice at the end.
Compare your connections with the picture, then continue.

SRC_TC.title: Change the cables: UUT sources a thermocouple (Type K)
SRC_TC.summary: Type K wire from the UUT TC jack through copper / Type K junctions in the lag bath to the external DMM (Figure 10, DMM in place of the 5522A).
steps: Put the calibrator (or the source) in STANDBY before you rewire (in manual mode, put it in STANDBY yourself).
External DMM in dc millivolts. Type K to copper junctions welded or in tight screw terminals, in the lag bath at room temperature; measure the bath with the standard thermometer (printed p. 25).
Thermocouple source, linear mode, Type K, ITS-90, internal reference, degC. Wait 1 minute for thermal emfs and 15 minutes for the bath.
Compare your connections with the picture, then continue.

LOOP.title: Change the cables: loop power
LOOP.summary: UUT mA jack and common -> external DMM INPUT HI / LO (Figure 13).
steps: Put the calibrator (or the source) in STANDBY before you rewire (in manual mode, put it in STANDBY yourself).
SETUP, ENTER, select Loop Power, ENTER. When complete, disable Loop Power in the setup menu or turn the UUT off (printed p. 30).
Compare your connections with the picture, then continue.

HART.title: Change the cables: HART mode (754 only)
HART.summary: UUT mA jack and common -> HART transmitter (Figure 15).
steps: Put the calibrator (or the source) in STANDBY before you rewire (in manual mode, put it in STANDBY yourself).

SETUP, HART Channel, ENTER, select mA Jack, ENTER. Connect to the HART transmitter as Figure 15, push HART (enable Loop Power if needed). The Active Device screen must show the transmitter (printed p. 31).
Compare your connections with the picture, then continue.

steps.switch: HART mode (754)
steps.question: Does the 754 recognize the HART transmitter (the Active Device screen shows the model number and tag, PV, PVAO, PV LRV and PV URV)?  Yes = recognized (pass).  No = not recognized (the test has failed: repair is necessary).
steps.note: HART Mode Verification (754 only), printed pp. 31-32: pass / fail only, no calibration. Setup: HART Channel = mA Jack; connect the 754 to a HART transmitter (Rosemount 1151 or 3051, or any HART device) per Figure 15; push HART, enable Loop Power if needed.
